question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 19 days and B can do the same job in 15 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 3 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
solution:
**Given:**

A can do the work in 19 days

B can do the work in 15 days

A, B and C together can do the work in 3 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = Rate × Time

Individual rate = Total work ÷ Time

Combined rate = Sum of individual rates

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 19, 15 and 3 = 285

⇒ Total work = 285 units

⇒ A’s 1 day work = 285 ÷ 19 = 15

⇒ B’s 1 day work = 285 ÷ 15 = 19

⇒ (A + B + C)’s 1 day work = 285 ÷ 3 = 95

⇒ (A + B)’s 1 day work = 15 + 19 = 34

⇒ C’s 1 day work = 95 − 34 = 61

⇒ Time taken by C alone = 285 ÷ 61

⇒ Time taken by C alone = 4(41)/(61) { days}

**∴ The correct answer is 4(41)/(61) { days}.**
